name: Tarmac Aberthaw Cement Works
notes: Active integrated cement plant at East Aberthaw / Rhoose. Cement kilns are a known recurring VIIRS industrial heat source; not a wildfire. Adjacent to the former Aberthaw Power Station (decommissioned 2020; CCR Energy demolition/remediation), which should not be confused with this live works.

name: Milford Haven industrial complex (Angle watch pin)
operator: Valero / Dragon LNG / South Hook LNG / Pembroke Power (complex)
notes: Persistent night VIIRS heat near Angle / Milford Haven waterway. History since mid-June 2026 shows recurring weak night detections (~180 hits / ~44 days in a ~3 km box; almost all night; typical FRP ~1–2 MW). Consistent with industrial process heat / flaring in the refinery–LNG–power strip, not a spreading wildfire. A major landscape fire here would be expected to differ (stronger FRP, day+night persistence, spatial growth). Pin is the recurring FIRMS centroid used for screening; individual plant footprints (Valero Rhoscrowther, Dragon LNG, South Hook, Pembroke Power) lie within a few kilometres.
